## Front Index

The front index points to the element that will be removed next.

![front points to the first element that can be removed](data:image/png;base64,)

front = 0 points to the first element (77) that will be removed next.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)

Next, you'll learn how to enqueue elements in a fixed-size queue.
